Open-pit copper-gold mine (flotation), north-central British Columbia. Open-pit gold mine with heap-leach processing (adsorption/desorption/refining on site), Kayseri province, Türkiye. Main deposit Keltepe (~90% of contained gold). FY2025: gold production cost $1,199/oz; AISC $1,613/oz (by-product basis); total capital expenditures $38.3M. Full operations resumed June 2023 after May 2023 EIA approval. Molybdenum mine, Idaho. On care and maintenance; P&P Mo reserves 112.989 Mt @ 0.065% = 161 Mlbs Mo. Company announced Sept 2023 PFS and Sept 2024 feasibility study/strategic integrated business plan for a molybdenum business unit restart (Thompson Creek Mine restart + Langeloth Metallurgical Facility ramp-up). No FY2025 production.

Molybdenum mine, British Columbia (75% interest). On care and maintenance since July 1, 2015; ~10 employees as of Dec 31, 2025. M&I Mo resources 166 Mlbs (50.522 Mt @ 0.074% measured + 122.175 Mt @ 0.040% indicated).

Gold-copper development project, north-central BC (100%). PEA announced Jan 19, 2026: 15-year mine life, open pit first then underground ~2 years later; avg annual production 171 koz gold + 61 Mlbs copper; AISC $971/oz (by-product basis); after-tax NPV5% ~$1.1B and IRR ~16% at $3,000/oz Au, $4.50/lb Cu; initial non-sustaining capex $771M + $277M expansion capex. PFS expected 2027. M&I resources (inclusive): Main open pit 170.513 Mt @ 0.30 g/t Au (1,668 koz), South open pit 13.204 Mt (158 koz), underground 33.223 Mt @ 0.82 g/t (877 koz), Kemess East 27.491 Mt @ 0.64 g/t (565 koz); indicated copper 1,146 Mlbs, silver 10.78 Moz. Q4 2025 impairment reversal $144.8M.

Gold development project, Nevada (100%). Technical study announced Aug 6, 2025; company proceeding with development. P&P reserves 33.348 Mt @ 0.66 g/t = 706 koz Au. FY2025 technical study forecasts ~7-year mine life, avg annual gold production ~100 koz between 2029 and 2032, life-of-mine AISC $1,392/oz; first production expected by end of 2028; total 533 koz gold. Hedging strategy covers 50% of 2029-2030 gold production with $3,200/oz floor and $4,435/oz average cap.

Flagship gold-silver project in Durango State, Mexico; one of the largest undeveloped gold-silver deposits in the Americas. Development stage: advancing a PFS in 2026 based on proprietary sulphide heap oxidation/leach technology for Phase 1. 2023 Amended PEA (eff. Dec 15, 2022) superseded earlier milling studies. Updated MRE (2021/2022 drilling, pit shell, 0.26 g/t AuEq cutoff): M+I 921.2 Mt @ 0.57 g/t Au, 14.3 g/t Ag = 16.77 Moz Au, 423.2 Moz Ag; Inferred 139.5 Mt @ 0.47 g/t Au, 13.2 g/t Ag = 2.13 Moz Au, 59.0 Moz Ag. Earlier 2016 updated PFS (milling route) reported P&P reserves of 1,102.3 Mt @ 0.764 g/t AuEq, 0.516 g/t Au, 14.2 g/t Ag, 0.164% Zn = 18.28 Moz Au, 501.6 Moz Ag, 4.0 Blb Zn (no longer the development basis). Also holds the Lucy exploration project and the Talapoosa project (Nevada).

Underground gold mine (Gwanda, Zimbabwe). 100%-basis production 76,213 oz; attributable 64% = 48,776 oz. 826,839 t milled (record, 98.7% of 838 ktpa capacity); grade not disclosed for 2025. H2 2025 affected by lower tonnages from higher-grade areas + electricity interruptions. Central Shaft commissioned. Mine-level costs not disclosed (group on-mine cost $1,263/oz, AISC $1,952/oz). FY26 guidance (100%): 72,000–76,500 oz, on-mine cost $1,500–1,700/oz, AISC $2,100–2,300/oz.

Oxide heap-leach operation; produced and sold 1,683 oz in 2025. Main Bilboes sulphide project in development (feasibility study / S-K 1300 TRS completed): P&P reserves 24.1 Mt @ 2.3 g/t (1,749 Koz) at 100% attributable. Development capex; solar optionality under study.
Exploration-stage project (acquired via Bilboes): M&I resources (excl. reserves) 7.9 Mt @ 1.71 g/t (436 Koz), Inferred 4.6 Mt @ 1.56 g/t (229 Koz), 100% attributable. No production.
Exploration-stage mining lease (acquired Nov 2022 from Bulawayo Mining for $8.25M via Motapa Mining Company UK Ltd/Arraskar). No production.

WA. Acquired Nov 2025 from Avoca Resources. Maiden UG reserve 0.37 Moz. Federal environmental approval Jun 2026; state environmental review in progress. ORE 3.31 Moz (OP) + 0.37 Moz (UG). No FY26 production.

Flagship project in Tanah Merah, Kelantan, Malaysia (~10 km, 2,370 acres). 81%-owned via CMNM Mining Group Sdn Bhd. Deposits: Manson's Lode, New Discovery, New Found, Sg. Ketubong, Rixen; first gold pour 21 Jul 2010. Open-pit and underground gold mining; CIL plant capacity raised 60% to 800 tpd with commercial production from May 2025; 2H2025 CIL gold output +65%. FY2025: 26,039 oz fine gold produced from CIL plant (+45% YoY), avg realized price US$3,589/oz (+46%). AISC US$1,357/oz (+5.9%), all-in costs US$1,459/oz (World Gold Council guidelines). Gold production/sales figures exclude gold produced from the flotation plant (base-metal concentrates: silver, lead, zinc). Two additional underground vertical shafts under construction at New Found (~358 m) and Manson's Lode (~335 m). Grade 1.7 g/t is the CIL resource grade; reserve grade 1.6 g/t. By-product (silver/lead/zinc) production quantities not disclosed (null).
100%-owned greenfield project via Kelgold Mining Sdn Bhd, ~30 km northwest of Sokor, Kelantan, Malaysia (~11 sq km). Exploration resumed in 2H2025; no reserves or production (null).
51%-owned via CNMC Pulai Mining Sdn Bhd, Kelantan, Malaysia. No mine-level production or reserve data disclosed in FY2025 materials (null).

Open pit gold mine, Alaska; 30% owned via Peak Gold JV (Kinross 70%, operator/manager); ore trucked to Kinross Fort Knox for toll processing. FY2025 (100% basis): 1,069,000 tons processed @ 0.20 oz/ton Au, 93% recovery, ~198,500 oz recovered. Contango 30% share: ~59,500 oz produced; 57,800 oz Au and 57,315 oz Ag sold; total gold sales $196.7M at avg realized $3,400/oz (14,061 oz at spot, 43,739 oz into hedges; 43,000 oz hedged remaining). Cash distributions received $102.0M. Cash cost $1,459/oz sold, AISC $1,616/oz sold (by-product basis). 2026 guidance: 70,000-75,000 oz at $1,500-$1,600/oz; 2027: 75,000-80,000 oz at $1,200-$1,300/oz. Grade 0.20 oz/ton = 6.86 g/t. No reserve table disclosed in 10-K (field null).

25% interest in the Schaft Creek Joint Venture (Teck Resources 75%, operator), a large porphyry copper-gold-molybdenum-silver project in the Golden Triangle / Tahltan Territory, NW BC. 2013 FS (100% basis): 130,000 tpd open pit; capex US$3.256B; 21-year mine life. P&P reserves (2013 FS): 940.8 Mt @ 0.27% Cu, 0.0176% Mo, 0.19 g/t Au, 1.72 g/t Ag = 5.6 Blb Cu, 5.7 Moz Au, 363.5 Mlb Mo, 51.7 Moz Ag. 2021 PEA evaluated a 133,000 tpd case on M+I resources of 1,345.5 Mt @ 0.26% Cu, 0.16 g/t Au, 0.017% Mo, 1.25 g/t Ag. JV considering transition to PFS stage; 2025 budget C$15.8M (C$15.3M spent); five-hole 2025 drill program south of Liard zone hit copper-gold mineralization. JV terms: Teck funds first $60M pre-production (done; +$30M above), Copper Fox 25% costs offset against two remaining $20M milestone payments; Teck may loan the 25% share beyond $220M cumulative. Teck/Anglo American merger approved Dec 2025.

Fourth mine K2 brought into commercial production Jun 2026 quarter (record 31,886 oz quarter). AISC A$2,738/oz converted at 0.65.

Plutonic Belt. Part of three-mine growth pipeline (Trident, Old Highway, Cinnamon), fully funded from balance sheet. No FY26 production.

Cash cost converted from R1,064,447/kg. Brakpan TSF approaching final phase; recommissioning adjacent Withok TSF (310 Mt capacity, ~20-year life at 1.3 Mtpm) planned in next 3–4 years. Ergo LoM 22 years. Crown Complex added to reserves in FY25.

DP2 plant expansion (to double throughput) + regional tailings storage facility (RTSF, 800 Mt, one-third completed Q1 FY2027) underway; Driefontein 4 TSF in final stages of operating life. FWGR LoM 16 years.

Gold mining complex near Timmins, Ontario (Hoyle Pond, Hollinger, Borden, Pamour, Dome mine and mill). rows.Mine: Colosseum Gold and Rare Earth Element (REE) Project
rows.Notes: 100%-owned development project in San Bernardino County, California, <10 km north of the Mountain Pass REE mine (similar geology). Historic open-pit gold mine operated 1988-1993 by LAC and Barrick, producing 344,000 oz. Technically simple open-pit restart envisaged in May 2026 BFS: 75 koz avg first 6 yrs, 102 koz peak year 6, 573 koz over 10.4 yrs; 55 koz of Inferred Mineral Resources within the pit shell not included in the Ore Reserve. REE upside: ~3,000 m REE-focused drilling complete (2026, expanded to 18 holes); specific gravity 2.8-3.1 g/cm3 aligning with gravity anomalies. 2026 gold drilling extended mineralisation NE of North Pit: 287.3 m @ 1.05 g/t Au (CM25-41), 214 m @ 1.06 g/t (CM26-42), both from surface, open at depth. US Government support at high levels for gold & REE developments. Legal: April 2026 NPCA proceedings named US federal agencies (not the company) re Colosseum; company states permitted activities continue under its Plan of Operations (valid existing rights). FID/construction targeted 2026. Other 100%-owned projects: Argos Strontium Project (4 patented claims, Cady Mountains, San Bernardino County) and Music Valley HREE Project (57 claims, 1,140 acres, Riverside County). Underground gold mine (Triangle mine) in Val-d'Or, Quebec; ore processed at the Sigma mill. 2025 production 187,208 oz (down 5% from 196,538 oz in 2024) on lower grades and recoveries, partly offset by higher throughput. Recovery 94.3%.
